_README: This file is the week's voice. Planning Center supplies the facts — order of service, songs, giving totals, sign-up links and dates, groups. Everything here is what a person writes. Edit it in the admin page at /sunday/admin/, or edit it here directly if you are comfortable with JSON. Links are written by NAME, not by ID: {"signup": "discover sojo"} is looked up against live Planning Center every build, so a sign-up that gets closed or deleted quietly drops off the page instead of 404ing a guest.
label: BABEL · Week One

try_five._README: The second button beside Connect Card. Point this at the Hello Church 'will you try 5?' form once it exists. Until then it falls back to the plan-a-visit page.

hero.headline:
One kind of seeing
takes.
The other covers.
hero.lede: How do you tell the difference between being wanted and being loved? Genesis 6 has four verses most people skip — heavenly beings saw that the daughters of men were beautiful, and they took. The Bible follows what came of that for a thousand years. This morning we follow it too, to a mountain at the gate of the dead, where Jesus asked his friends who they said he was.
hero.art_alt: BABEL — a five-week series at SOJO Church. Old gods. New names. Genesis 11 to Acts 2.

welcome_note: Welcome. If this is your first Sunday here, you picked an unusual one — stay with it, nothing is required of you but listening. Fill out a Connect Card if you haven't already, and then give us five Sundays. That's about how long it takes to stop feeling like a visitor.

flow._README: Planning Center gives the order. These rename items and add the one line of detail a guest needs. Keys match the PCO item title, lowercased. 'hide' drops an item. 'insert' adds something PCO does not carry. '{{songs}}' expands to the worship set, '{{songs_after}}' to the response song.

message.title: The Message
message.detail: Pastor Corey · The Gate — Genesis 6, a mountain in the north, and the question Jesus asked at the gate of the dead.

communion.title: Communion
communion.detail: In a first-century wedding the groom offered a cup, and if she drank, she had said yes. That is the cup Jesus handed his friends. The table is open to anyone who follows him — if that's not you yet, no pressure, just let it pass.

baptism.title: Baptism
baptism.detail: Somebody is going public with their faith this morning. The next Baptism Sunday is October 25 — text BAPTIZE to 980-440-2850 and someone will walk you through it.

closing announcements.title: Sending
closing announcements.detail: Shoeboxes, Wednesday nights, and where to be next.

note_prompts: Where have you settled for being wanted?
What did you hear in Ezekiel 16 that you did not expect?
Who do you say that he is?

study_guide._README: The Go Deeper block under the note prompts. Give it either a google_doc_id (it becomes a PDF download link) or a url. Leave the whole block out on a week with no guide and nothing renders.
study_guide.title: The Gate — the long version
study_guide.body: Every passage behind this morning, the three ways Christians have read Genesis 6, what the Book of Enoch is and is not, the mountain, and a reading list. Twenty pages. You do not need it to follow Jesus — it is here for the ones who want the texts in front of them.

ways.text: Made out to SOJO Church. Hand it to an usher when they come by.

ways.label: Cash
ways.text: Use an envelope and put your name on it — that's the only way we can credit the gift to you at the end of the year.

ways.label: Online
ways.text: One time or recurring, from your phone. Takes about a minute.

fallback.asof: Giving figures are updated each week from Planning Center.

announcements.title: Operation Christmas Child
announcements.body: Grab an empty shoebox at the Mill, fill it, bring it back. One box is one kid finding out that somebody they will never meet knows their name.

announcements.title: Genesis 1–11
announcements.body: The soil this whole series grows out of, slowly, with your questions welcome. Youth and adults meet separately.

announcements.title: Discover SOJO
announcements.body: Lunch, childcare, and the people behind all this. If you are new, this is the one to come to.

announcements.title: Youth Harvest Night
announcements.body: Pumpkins, a fire pit, s'mores, and a devotional at the Bowens'. Bring a chair.

swag.title: Every shirt is a Bible
swag.body: Printed on demand when you order it, so nothing sits in a box in a closet. And every piece that sells puts a Bible in the hands of somebody who just met Jesus.

pastor_notes.title: Why we are going here
pastor_notes.body: Five weeks in Genesis 6 to 12, and then Acts. I want three things to be true in you by the end. One: there are powers bent against God, and they work by hurting the people he made in his image. Two: the thing everyone is building right now is not neutral, and I think it is going to cost us. Three — and this is the one I actually care about — there is a Kingdom that Jesus died to open, and you can taste how good God is inside it. Every week stands on its own. Nothing to catch up on.

pastor_notes.title: About the leaders you prayed over
pastor_notes.body: Last Sunday you stood up and prayed over our new small group leaders. I want you to know what you were actually doing. You were sending people out. Every one of them is opening a table this fall — a living room, a meal, and a seat at it for somebody who does not have a place yet. If you prayed for them, finish the prayer. Go sit at one of those tables.

pastor_notes.title: Give us five Sundays
pastor_notes.body: If you are new, this is the only thing I will ask of you today. Not membership. Not a commitment. Five Sundays. That is about how long it takes to stop scanning the room and start recognizing faces — to stop being a visitor and start being somebody who gets missed when you are not here. Tap Try 5 up top and let us know you are in. Then come to Discover SOJO on the 25th and meet us properly.

invite.lede: Everybody you know is watching the same world you are and quietly wondering what is going on with it. This series says it out loud. Bring one person who has been asking.
invite.text: Come with me to church Sunday — we're in a series about why the world feels the way it does right now, and how God's plan is better than anything we could build. 9:00 or 11:00 at Gibson Mill, 325 McGill Ave. About an hour and change. https://sojo.church

groups._README: Used only if the Planning Center Groups read comes back empty.

buttons._README: The two calls to action under the order of service and under the groups list. A button whose link will not resolve is dropped rather than shipped dead.

live._README: The /live page. youtube_channel_id makes the embed find whatever that channel is streaming, so nobody hunts for a video ID each week. replay_video_id is set after the service to turn the page into the replay with working chapters.
